mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.author_id, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.save_count, p.report_count, p.weight, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username AS author_name FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.author_id, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.save_count, p.report_count, p.weight, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username AS author_name FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.author_id, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.save_count, p.report_count, p.weight, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username AS author_name FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.author_id, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.save_count, p.report_count, p.weight, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username AS author_name FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.category = #{category} AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.author_id, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.save_count, p.report_count, p.weight, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username AS author_name FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.author_id = #{authorId}

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.author_id, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.save_count, p.report_count, p.weight, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username AS author_name FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.author_id, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.save_count, p.report_count, p.weight, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username AS author_name FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.weight DESC

SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content, p.category, p.author_id, p.status, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.save_count, p.report_count, p.weight, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.username AS author_name FROM posts p JOIN users u ON p.author_id = u.id WHERE p.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY p.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (title, content, category, author_id, status, like_count, comment_count, save_count, report_count, weight) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{authorId}, #{status}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{saveCount}, #{reportCount}, #{weight})
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, category = #{category}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
